complexity.notes: Selecting each of the N output nodes by an O(k) head scan costs O(N*k) overall; a heap or divide-and-conquer merge would give O(N log k). The ListNode(NotImplemented) sentinel works (int == NotImplemented is False) but is obscure compared to a plain None/dummy check. Merging the explicit '< min_val' test with the min() call is redundant bookkeeping.
complexity.summary: Repeatedly linear-scans the current list heads to find the minimum-valued node, appends it to the result, and advances that list, dropping empty lists as they are exhausted; a shortcut breaks the scan early when a head equals the previously appended value.
